financial.text: Sean Hannigan joined WPI as Associate Vice President for Facilities and Capital Planning, reporting to the EVP/CFO. He leads campus planning, facilities operations, design and construction, and sustainability initiatives, overseeing a team of ~110 and a budget of more than $40M, with a stated mandate to implement WPI's comprehensive campus master plan.
